---
title: "R Shiny Apps"
description: "Interactive Shiny applications that ship with the olsrr, blorr, descriptr, inferr, rfm, vistributions and xplorerr packages. Run them locally from R."
---

::: {.callout-note}
### These apps run on your machine

Every R package listed here includes a Shiny app. The apps run **locally in
R** — install the package from CRAN and launch from your console. There is no
hosted version: the service that previously hosted these apps is no longer
under my control, so rather than ship links that fail, each card below gives
you the exact command.
:::

## Regression and modeling

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-olsrr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the olsrr R package"}

### olsrr {.card-title}

Build linear regression models and iterate through specifications quickly.
Produces full olsrr model output from the UI.

```r
install.packages("olsrr")
olsrr::ols_launch_app()
```
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-blorr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the blorr R package"}

### blorr {.card-title}

Build, validate and monitor binary logistic regression models with
comprehensive output, model fit and validation statistics.

```r
install.packages("blorr")
blorr::blr_launch_app()
```
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-xplorerr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the xplorerr R package"}

### xplorerr {.card-title}

One app, seven entry points. Linear and logistic regression, descriptive
statistics, inference, RFM analysis, distributions and the visualizer.

```r
install.packages("xplorerr")
xplorerr::app_linear_regression()
```

Also available: `app_descriptive()`, `app_visualizer()`,
`app_logistic_regression()`, `app_inference()`, `app_rfm_analysis()`,
`app_vistributions()`.
:::
:::

## Statistics

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-descriptr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the descriptr R package"}

### descriptr {.card-title}

Generate and visualize descriptive statistics for numeric and categorical
data. Explore key statistical distributions with interactive plots.

```r
install.packages("descriptr")
descriptr::ds_launch_shiny_app()
```
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-inferr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the inferr R package"}

### inferr {.card-title}

Beginner-friendly hypothesis testing with parametric and non-parametric
tests, flexible input options and structured results.

```r
install.packages("inferr")
inferr::ifr_launch_shiny_app()
```
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-vistributions.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the vistributions R package"}

### vistributions {.card-title}

Visualize probability distributions and run statistical quality checks on
univariate data.

```r
install.packages("vistributions")
vistributions::vdist_launch_app()
```
:::
:::

## Customer analytics

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-rfm.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the rfm R package"}

### rfm {.card-title}

Customer segmentation using recency, frequency and monetary value analysis.
Build customized segments from customer- or transaction-level data.

```r
install.packages("rfm")
rfm::rfm_launch_app()
```
:::
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### nse2r has no app

`nse2r` exported an `nse_app()` Shiny entry point, but the package was
**archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07** and is under revival, so it is
deliberately excluded from this page rather than shipped with a command that
cannot be run. See [Packages](packages/) for its current status.
:::
